set -e
src=/mnt/workspace/megatron-lm
tmp=/mnt/workspace/.megatron-lm.tmp
rm -rf "$tmp"
if [ -d "$src" ]; then
  echo "Using pre-seeded workspace at $src"
elif [ -d /opt/megatron-lm ]; then
  mkdir -p "$tmp"
  cp -a /opt/megatron-lm/. "$tmp"
  mv "$tmp" "$src"
  echo "Copied Megatron-LM from image at /opt/megatron-lm"
else
  repo="https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM.git"
  git clone --depth 1 -b core_v0.15.2 "$repo" "$tmp"
  mv "$tmp" "$src"
  echo "Cloned Megatron-LM from the configured source repo"
fi
